        b = n['boundary']
        rmin = min(r for r,c in b)
        cmin = min(c for r,c in b)
        rmax = max(r for r,c in b)
        cmax = max(c for r,c in b)
        if rmin >= 30:
            print(f"  id={n['id']:2d} color={n['color']:2s} px={n['pixels']:4d} rect=[{rmin},{cmin}]-[{rmax},{cmax}]")
print("Level completed:", result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
